purpose: Three original Inquello logo and wordmark concept boards for review
reference_use: User-supplied UI screenshots interpreted for visual context; no image files passed to generation.
base: Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished ORIGINAL visual identity CONCEPT BOARD for Inquello, an AI workspace for auditors across internal audit, external audit, advisory and IT/IS. The product helps people investigate, analyse, create and review work in existing files and tools. Personality: capable, quietly confident, thoughtful, precise and approachable. This is a brand design exploration, not a certification mark. Its existing app is a restrained professional light desktop workspace: near-white content canvas, pale gray sidebar, very dark ink text, muted cobalt blue highlights, subtle thin separators. Logo must look excellent in that interface. Render as crisp flat vector-like graphic design, no texture, 3D, bevel, shiny mockups or gradients. Large generous white/off-white margins; precise graphic design presentation. Exact wordmark text: "Inquello" spelled capital I, n, q, u, e, l, l, o. No tagline. Keep wordmark clearly legible with careful optical kerning. A distinctive freestanding symbol and a beautiful horizontal symbol+wordmark lockup are essential. Build each image as ONE concept board, landscape aspect ratio, with a very large hero horizontal lockup across the upper-middle, bottom left positive/inverse standalone symbol tiles, bottom middle a much smaller horizontal lockup for small-size judgement, bottom right a minimal realistic sidebar masthead sample with pale gray background showing this mark beside Inquello. A dark charcoal strip can show a reversed white version. Use minimal tiny panel captions only, no invented explanatory prose. Avoid: shields, padlocks, checkmarks, gavels, scales, magnifying glasses, brains, robots, sparkle stars, networks of nodes, eyes, infinity loops, ornate crests, generic existing AI knot logos. Do not imitate the branding of Codex, OpenAI, Anthropic, Claude, Diligent, or any existing company. Monochrome design must carry the identity; a small restrained muted-cobalt accent is permitted only in one optional application tile.

Concept A — OPEN INQUIRY. Make a beautifully balanced geometric q-inspired symbol: a substantial softly squared lowercase q, a single controlled opening in the bowl and a short VERTICAL descender integrated into its right stroke. Use broad filled geometry and elegant negative space. Let the negative space feel like a deliberate opening for a question; extremely simple and optically distinctive at small size. The vertical descender must be part of the q geometry, never a diagonal magnifying-glass handle or a speech-bubble point. No inner dot. Flat black symbol on white. Pair it with a bespoke modern humanist sans-serif wordmark, medium weight, open counters, subtle softened details, credible sophisticated product lettering. The q in the wordmark subtly echoes the symbol's terminal without sacrificing reading. Top-left small heading text "A / Open Inquiry". Focus on a strong memorable silhouette and highly refined typography.

This concept must look angular, editorial and grounded, distinctly different from a round q logo.

Crisp practical identity for a capable professional work partner.
